turns.replyText:
What should I do if the tracking never updates?

Hi, if the tracking has not updated yet, the first thing to know is that tracking usually does not appear until the carrier scans the package. Until that first scan happens, it can look like nothing is moving even though the order is still on its way through shipping prep.

What to do:

Check your email, including spam or junk, for the tracking message from Heirloom.
If the status only says something like tracking is pending or waiting for details, that usually means the tracking number has been created but the package has not been scanned yet.
If there have been no carrier updates for 72 hours or more after tracking was issued, we should have our team review it.

If you want, send me your order number or the email used at checkout and I can check the order status for you.

Can I reroute the package to a different address?

Hi, yes, if you need to change the shipping address on an order, that is handled by phone so the team can update it securely and make sure any tax adjustment tied to the new location is processed correctly.

Please call our customer care team at (800) 820-0465. We are available Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST.

They’ll be happy to help get the address updated.
